note: Deliverable contract for every pipeline. Read by scripts/new_run.py and scripts/run_status.py. Section headings ship bilingual (en/vi); the `write` line is scaffold guidance that the author replaces with real content.

modes.focused: Smallest complete set that can answer the request and be acted on.
modes.system: Connected set across strategy, creative, channel, and measurement.
modes.production: Everything plus machine-readable manifests, prompts, and export handoff.

plan-from-zero.title: Marketing plan from zero
plan-from-zero.use_when: User has a product, service, or shop and no marketing plan. Includes market assessment, positioning, offer, messaging, copy, channels, budget, calendar, measurement.

deliverables.title: Intake and truth map
deliverables.title_vi: Tiếp nhận và bản đồ sự thật
deliverables.gate: Every field is labelled confirmed / observed / inferred / unknown. No unknown has been promoted into a fact.

sections.write: Quote the user verbatim. Do not clean it up.
What the thing actually is, what it does, how it works, what it costs, where it is available.

sections.vi: Đã xác nhận / quan sát / suy luận / chưa biết
sections.write: One table. Every row carries a label and a source or the reason for the inference.
Usable assets, licences, people who may appear, claims that are prohibited.
At most three, and only where the answer changes the plan. State the assumption you will run on if unanswered.
Pipeline, mode, languages, and what is explicitly out of scope.

deliverables.title: Research plan
deliverables.gate: Every research question names its source tier and its stop condition.

sections.write: Turn the vague request into independently answerable questions, typed (market size, competitor fact, customer language, platform spec, regulation, price, trend).
Query set per question, including Vietnamese-language and platform-native queries.
Which tier of source may support which claim type.
What counts as enough evidence per question.

deliverables.title: Market assessment
deliverables.gate: Every number has a source URL with a retrieval date or is marked inferred with its arithmetic shown. Sizing is bottom-up and expressed as a range.

sections.write: What was researched, how, and what was not.
The category as the customer would describe it, not as the industry names it.
Triangulate at least three independent signals. Name the bias in each.
Bottom-up build with the arithmetic visible: reachable population, frequency, average order value, capture rate. Give a low/base/high range.
Direct, indirect, substitute, and do-nothing. Comparison matrix on axes that predict switching.
Two axes built from observable attributes. Mark the empty space and say whether it is empty for a good reason.
Observed competitor prices with sources, and where this product can sit.
Regulatory, supply, seasonality, platform dependency, concentration.

sections.en: Confidence and what would change this
sections.vi: Độ tin cậy và điều có thể thay đổi kết luận
sections.write: Per-conclusion confidence label, plus the specific evidence that would overturn it.

deliverables.title: Audience insight
deliverables.gate: Customer language is quoted verbatim from a real source, not paraphrased or invented.

sections.write: One segment, chosen behaviourally or situationally, not demographically. Say why this one first.

sections.en: Situation and job to be done
sections.vi: Bối cảnh và việc cần làm
sections.write: The moment the need appears, described concretely enough to film.
Unaware, problem-aware, solution-aware, product-aware, or most-aware. This decides the headline job.
Push, pull, habit, anxiety. Anxiety and habit are what actually block the sale.
Ranked, with where in the read each one surfaces.
Verbatim phrases with source. This becomes the copy vocabulary.
Platforms, surfaces, and moments, with evidence.

deliverables.title: Positioning
deliverables.gate: The differentiating idea survives the substitution test: a competitor cannot claim it truthfully.

sections.write: The set the customer compares against. Choosing the frame is most of positioning.
Who, in what situation, at what trigger.

sections.vi: Ý tưởng khác biệt duy nhất
sections.write: One sentence. If it needs two, positioning is not decided yet.
Why the claim is structurally true. The most skipped and highest-leverage element.
What makes it believable today, with what exists now, not what could be gathered later.
A position with no sacrifice is not a position.
Internal working sentence, not a tagline.
The claims and looks this brand must not adopt, and why.

deliverables.title: Offer
deliverables.gate: Scarcity, guarantee, and price are all real and deliverable. Nothing here would embarrass the business if audited.

sections.write: What the buyer actually walks away with, in their words.
Dream outcome, perceived likelihood, time delay, effort. Score each and name the weakest lever.
Core, bonuses, guarantee, urgency, name, price presentation.
Number, currency formatting, anchoring, and what is bundled or unbundled.
The specific mechanism that removes the buyer's downside, and its real cost to the business.

sections.vi: Khẩn cấp thật hoặc không có
sections.write: If there is no genuine deadline or limit, say so and do not fabricate one.
Concrete and specific. Not 'Premium Package'.

deliverables.title: Messaging architecture
deliverables.gate: Every message links to a claim ID in claims.csv. Prohibited claims are listed explicitly.

sections.write: Tension, promise, mechanism, proof, action. Write all five as sentences.
One line that survives being read alone, out of context.
Message to proof to claim ID. Any message without proof is downgraded or cut.

sections.vi: Thông điệp theo mức nhận thức
sections.write: The same product, said five ways, one per stage.
How the primary message compresses into each surface without becoming a different promise.
Superlatives, health or efficacy claims, comparative claims, and anything unverified. Cite the rule where one applies.
Register, address form, three do-say and three never-say examples, in both languages.

deliverables.title: Copy pack
deliverables.gate: Passes the edit sweep: no filler, no unproven claim, no LLM tell, no untranslatable direct rendering between languages.

sections.write: Ten or more, tagged by pattern and awareness stage. Kill any that could headline a competitor.
Block by block with the job of each block named.
Primary text, headline, description per placement, within real character limits.
Native to each platform's reading behaviour, not one caption reposted.
Hook in the first three seconds, then beats with on-screen text.
Email, SMS, or Zalo, with trigger, delay, single job, and suppression rule per message.

sections.vi: Mô tả sản phẩm và món
sections.write: Sensory and specific. For menus, respect the length the layout allows.
One primary action per surface, with the friction-reducing microcopy underneath.

deliverables.title: Channel plan
deliverables.gate: At most two or three starting channels, each with a stated reason, cost, time-to-signal, and failure mode.

sections.write: Score candidates on audience presence, intent depth, money cost, time cost, speed of signal, compounding value, platform risk.
Two or three. Say what each is responsible for.

sections.vi: Kế hoạch vận hành từng kênh
sections.write: Asset types, cadence, targeting or distribution mechanic, owner, first-week actions.
Name the rejected channels and the reason. This is the part that protects the plan.

sections.vi: Rủi ro phụ thuộc nền tảng
sections.write: What breaks if one platform changes its rules, and the owned-audience hedge.

deliverables.title: 90-day calendar
deliverables.gate: Every item has an owner, a lead time, and a dependency. No week is fully booked.

sections.write: What must exist before day one: assets, tracking, inventory, permissions.
Week by week. Learning goal per week, not just activity.
What scales, what gets cut, based on which signal.
Compounding work and the second channel.

sections.vi: Thời gian chuẩn bị và phụ thuộc
sections.write: Print, shoot, approval, platform review. The things always underestimated.
The recurring meeting, the recurring report, the recurring decision.

deliverables.title: Budget and unit economics
deliverables.title_vi: Ngân sách và kinh tế đơn vị
deliverables.gate: The CAC ceiling is derived from contribution margin with arithmetic shown, not asserted.

sections.write: Price, variable cost, contribution margin per unit, in local currency, with the arithmetic.
Derive from contribution margin, repeat rate, and acceptable payback period. Show the calculation.
By channel and by phase, at the actual budget available.

sections.vi: Sản xuất so với truyền thông
sections.write: The ratio, and why. Under-producing creative wastes media; over-producing starves it.
A fixed percentage reserved for learning, protected from performance pressure.
Units and days at the planned spend.
Written in advance: what evidence moves money, and how much.

deliverables.title: Measurement contract
deliverables.gate: No awareness asset is judged on last-click. Every metric has a decision attached to it.

sections.vi: Chỉ số cốt lõi và cây chỉ số
sections.write: One business outcome, decomposed into the leading indicators that actually drive it.

sections.vi: Chỉ số hợp lệ theo giai đoạn
sections.write: What each funnel stage may be judged on, and what it may not.
What must be installed or named before spend starts: events, UTMs, codes, call tracking.
Platform-reported versus actual, view-through inflation, and what this business can legitimately conclude.
The metrics that stop a false winner: margin, refund rate, review score, cost per qualified action.
Weekly and monthly, with the template and the audience for each.
Written before the data arrives: at what threshold do we scale, hold, fix, or kill.

deliverables.title: Creative direction
deliverables.gate: Direction is derived from the product mechanism and audience behaviour, not from a visual trend.

sections.write: The idea space this brand owns, expressed so a photographer and a copywriter both know what to do.
Clear, distinctive-signature, and departure. What each is for and how budget splits.
Palette, light character, composition signature, type, texture, and the anti-references.
The minimum set of assets, with ratios and channels, that covers the plan. No blind Cartesian product.
Which follow-on pipeline runs next (image-from-reference, design-render, video-campaign) and with what locked inputs.

deliverables.title: Claim ledger
deliverables.gate: Every public-facing claim appears here with evidence, owner, status, and review date.

deliverables.title: Source map
deliverables.gate: Every URL was actually opened. No URL is reconstructed from memory.

sections.write: Official docs, regulation text, platform developer docs, the company's own pages. URL plus retrieval date plus what it supports.
Trade press and research with disclosed methodology.
Where customer language was mined, how it was sampled, how many items.
What was searched for and not found. This section is a feature, not an admission.

deliverables.title: Decision log
deliverables.gate: Every material choice has a recorded alternative that was rejected and why.

sections.write: Date, decision, alternative rejected, reason, confidence, who decides if wrong.
Unresolved assumptions the plan depends on, and what would invalidate each.
Concrete, owned, dated.

deep-research.title: Deep market research
deep-research.title_vi: Nghiên cứu thị trường chuyên sâu
deep-research.use_when: User wants to understand a market, competitors, customers, demand, or feasibility before committing. Also runs as the research stage inside plan-from-zero.

deliverables.title: Research intake
deliverables.gate: The decision the research must inform is stated in one sentence.

sections.write: Research with no decision attached is trivia. Name the decision.
Labelled confirmed / observed / inferred / unknown.
Geography, language, budget, timeline, and access limits.
Explicit.

deliverables.title: Research plan
deliverables.gate: Every question has a typed source strategy and a stop condition.

sections.write: Independently answerable, typed by claim category.

sections.vi: Kế hoạch tìm kiếm đa hướng
sections.write: By entity, category, complaint language, comparison, price, local-language term, platform-native search.

sections.vi: Phân tầng nguồn và quy tắc
sections.write: What may support a client-facing claim and what may not.
Per question.

deliverables.title: Market assessment
deliverables.gate: Bottom-up sizing with visible arithmetic and a stated range. Every external number sourced and dated.

sections.write: What was done and what was not.
As the customer defines it.
Three or more triangulated signals with their biases named.
TAM, SAM, SOM. Bottom-up build shown. Low, base, high.
Stage of the category, and what marketing works at that stage.

sections.vi: Độ tin cậy và điều kiện đảo ngược
sections.write: Per conclusion.

deliverables.title: Competitor analysis
deliverables.gate: Competitor claims are quoted from their own live surfaces with URLs, not characterised from memory.

sections.write: Direct, indirect, substitute, do-nothing. Say how the set was built.
Axes that predict switching, not feature checklists.

sections.vi: Kiểm toán định vị và thông điệp
sections.write: What each actually says, quoted, with URL and date.
Observed prices, bundles, guarantees, and promotional behaviour.

sections.vi: Kiểm toán sáng tạo và kênh
sections.write: Where they show up, what their creative pattern is, and what is saturated.
Where the set is uniformly weak, and whether that weakness is a real opportunity or a structural constraint.

deliverables.title: Customer evidence
deliverables.gate: Quotes are verbatim with source and date. Theme frequencies are counted, not estimated.

sections.write: Where, how many, how sampled, over what period.

sections.vi: Chủ đề đã mã hóa và tần suất
sections.write: Theme, count, share, representative verbatim.

sections.vi: Bản đồ khó khăn và mong đợi
sections.write: What actually hurts and what actually delights, ranked by frequency and intensity.
The exact words customers use. This becomes copy.
Including the ones people do not say out loud.

deliverables.title: Risk and regulation
deliverables.gate: Each restriction cites the instrument. Anything unconfirmed is marked unverified rather than paraphrased as settled law.

sections.vi: Giới hạn quảng cáo và tuyên bố
sections.write: Superlatives, comparative claims, health, food, cosmetic. Cite the law, decree, or circular.

sections.vi: Nghĩa vụ sản phẩm và nhãn
sections.write: Notification, food safety, labelling, and licensing where relevant.

sections.vi: Quy định dữ liệu và nền tảng
sections.write: Personal data obligations, ecommerce registration, invoicing, and platform policy.
Supply, seasonality, concentration, dependency.

sections.vi: Chưa xác minh và cần kiểm tra lại
sections.write: What could not be confirmed and who should confirm it.

deliverables.title: Findings brief
deliverables.gate: Readable in five minutes. Leads with the recommendation, not the process.

sections.write: The answer to the decision named in intake. First, not last.
Each with its number and its source.
The findings that contradicted the starting assumption.
What is still unknown and how much it matters.
Owned and dated.

deliverables.title: Claim ledger
deliverables.gate: Every load-bearing number appears here with source, date, and confidence.

deliverables.title: Source map
deliverables.gate: Every URL was actually opened.

sections.write: URL, retrieval date, what it supports.
With methodology noted.
Surfaces mined and sample size.
Searched for and not found.

image-from-reference.title: Image from reference
image-from-reference.use_when: User supplies photo A (product, dish, person, packaging, space) and wants branding imagery, product shots, or artistic key visuals derived from it.

deliverables.title: Intake and rights
deliverables.title_vi: Tiếp nhận và quyền sử dụng
deliverables.gate: Rights to every reference image are stated. If a real person appears, authorisation is recorded or the work stops.

sections.write: Each file, what it actually shows, resolution, and quality problems.
Who owns it, who appears in it, what use is authorised.
What the image must accomplish, where it will appear, at what size.
Identity, product form, label text, colour, proportion. Anything not locked can drift.
What may change, and what is an automatic rejection.

deliverables.title: Reference role map
deliverables.title_vi: Bản đồ vai trò ảnh tham chiếu
deliverables.gate: Every reference is assigned exactly one primary role. Unassigned references are removed, not passed through.

deliverables.title: Visual strategy
deliverables.gate: The direction is traceable to product mechanism and audience, not to a trend reference.

sections.en: What this image must make someone believe
sections.vi: Điều ảnh phải khiến người xem tin
sections.write: One sentence. Not 'look premium'.
First fixation, second, third. Design backwards from this.

sections.vi: Vùng sáng tạo và tham chiếu cần tránh
sections.write: Including the category default this must escape.
Where type will live, as a fraction of frame, so composition reserves it.

deliverables.title: Craft specification
deliverables.title_vi: Đặc tả kỹ thuật hình ảnh
deliverables.gate: Every craft field is a specific value or range, never an adjective. Lighting is specified geometrically.

sections.write: Studio, editorial, documentary, or native-social. This governs everything below.
Focal length, aperture, subject distance, and the perspective consequence.
Key source, modifier, size, azimuth and elevation in degrees, distance, ratio, fill, separation, background.
Contact shadow, cast shadow direction and softness, occlusion. The most common generative failure.
Palette with hue angles, lightness spread, saturation budget, white balance in Kelvin, grade direction.
Per surface: what light does to it, and the phrase that makes a model render it.
Shot size, camera height, placement, negative space budget, and the master ratio.
Pixel dimensions, colour space, format, sharpening recipe, per destination.

deliverables.title: Direction option cards
deliverables.gate: Three to five coded options. Each differs on a named axis, not on adjectives. A non-expert can choose by reading only the cards.

sections.write: One line: reply with the code. Say what happens next.
Per option: code, name, one-line promise, the craft delta, best for, weakness, and cost or difficulty.
Name one and give the reason in one sentence.

deliverables.title: Shot list
deliverables.gate: Every row has a defined job, channel, ratio, and acceptance gate.

deliverables.title: Provider prompts
deliverables.gate: One file per variant. Each names its provider, its single changed axis, and its locks. Producing a prompt is not rendering an image; never report otherwise.
deliverables.readme: One .txt per variant, named campaign-lane-channel-asset-ratio-variant-vNN.txt. Generate with scripts/compile_prompt.py from 04-craft-spec so the prompt and the spec cannot drift apart.

deliverables.title: QA and scoring
deliverables.gate: Critical failures reject outright regardless of score. Scores are recorded per variant with the rejection label.

sections.write: Identity drift, product or label falsehood, anatomy, physics, claim, rights, disclosure.
Strategy, fidelity, distinction, craft, channel, rights. Per variant, with the reason for each deduction.
Shadow direction agreement, contact shadow presence, reflection plausibility, depth-of-field consistency, scale.
Ship, revise one axis, or reject. Name the axis.

deliverables.title: Export and handoff
deliverables.gate: Every destination has verified live platform specs cited with a retrieval date.

sections.write: Pixels, ratio, colour space, format, maximum file size, safe zones. Cite the official source.
How the master becomes each ratio without blind cropping.
Recipe per destination, applied last.
The convention, applied consistently.

sections.vi: Văn bản thay thế và công bố
sections.write: Per asset, in both languages, plus any AI-generation or advertising disclosure required.

deliverables.title: Asset manifest
deliverables.gate: Generated by scripts/build_asset_manifest.py so filenames and the shot list cannot diverge.

design-render.title: Design and render
design-render.use_when: User needs a designed artefact: menu, wireframe, landing page layout, poster, packaging layout, one-pager, key visual with type. Produces option cards, a spec, and real rendered SVG or HTML output.

deliverables.title: Intake
deliverables.gate: Format, physical or pixel dimensions, production method, and budget are known or explicitly assumed.

sections.write: What is being designed, at what size, produced how.

sections.vi: Người đọc và bối cảnh đọc
sections.write: Lighting, distance, time available, device. This sets minimum type size.
What copy, prices, and images actually exist versus what is still placeholder.
Existing logo, palette, type, and whether they are locked or open.
Print capability, budget, timeline, languages, accessibility requirements.

deliverables.title: Content inventory
deliverables.gate: Every element that must appear is listed with its real length. No layout is designed against imaginary copy.

sections.write: Everything that must appear, with priority rank.

sections.vi: Nội dung thật và độ dài
sections.write: Actual strings and character counts, in both languages. Vietnamese runs longer; measure it.
What is level one, two, three. A layout supports few levels; choose them.
What must be written or photographed before this can be produced.

deliverables.title: Commercial analysis
deliverables.gate: For a menu: contribution margin and popularity are calculated per item with the arithmetic shown. For a page: the conversion job of each section is named.

sections.vi: Kinh tế theo món hoặc theo khối
sections.write: For menus, cost, price, and contribution margin per item. For pages, the action each section drives.

sections.vi: Ma trận độ phổ biến và biên lợi nhuận
sections.write: Classify every item, then say what to do with each class: promote, reprice, redesign, or remove.
What gets prime position and why, tied to the matrix rather than to taste.

sections.vi: Ghi chú chất lượng bằng chứng
sections.write: Which design-psychology effects used here are well supported and which are folklore. Do not present folklore as fact.

deliverables.title: Design option cards
deliverables.gate: Three coded directions that differ structurally, not decoratively. Each names its production cost and its risk.

sections.write: Reply with the code. State what gets rendered next.
Per option: code, name, positioning it signals, type and palette approach, grid, photo policy, format, production cost, weakness.
One choice, one reason, tied to the analysis rather than to preference.

deliverables.title: Design specification
deliverables.gate: Fully deterministic: another person could rebuild this file's output without asking a question.

sections.write: Trim, bleed, safe margin, columns, gutters, baseline, spacing unit.
Ratio, computed sizes, weights, line-heights, letter-spacing, and the minimum legible size for the reading situation. Confirm Vietnamese diacritic support and increase line-height accordingly.
Roles with hex and perceptual lightness, the accessible-pair matrix, and the CMYK or screen caveats.
Each repeating element specified once: item row, price treatment, section header, callout, image frame.

sections.vi: Quy tắc người không phải designer làm được
sections.write: Written as do-this-not-that, so execution survives without the designer.

deliverables.title: Wireframe
deliverables.gate: Text notation is unambiguous about order, hierarchy, and proportion. Responsive or multi-panel variants are included where the format needs them.

sections.write: So the reader needs no prior knowledge.
Block by block, top to bottom, with proportions and the job of each block.
Mobile, second panel, or alternate size.
Behaviour, states, constraints, and anything the render must honour.

deliverables.title: Rendered output
deliverables.gate: Real SVG or HTML files that open, plus the machine-readable JSON spec used by scripts/render_mockup.py. A wireframe render must not be described as final photography, print PDF, or video.
deliverables.readme: Store design-spec.json beside the generated SVG/HTML. The JSON must carry the approved content, theme, dimensions, colors, image path, and footer. Print PDF, raster export, and real image/video generation require separate capable tools and QA; state clearly when they were not produced.

deliverables.title: Print and export
deliverables.gate: A print shop could run this without a follow-up question.

sections.write: Trim, bleed, stock, weight, finish, colour mode, ink limit, quantity.

sections.vi: Danh sách kiểm tra trước in
sections.write: Resolution, fonts, colour conversion, minimum type size, rich black.
Pixel sizes, formats, and compression per destination.

sections.en: What will look different in print
sections.write: The specific colours that will shift, and the compensation.

deliverables.title: Image prompts for this design
deliverables.title_vi: Prompt ảnh cho thiết kế này
deliverables.gate: Each prompt states the exact crop, ratio, and copy-space the layout requires. Producing prompts is not producing images.
deliverables.readme: One .txt per image slot in the layout. Each is dimensioned to its frame in 05-design-spec, with the copy-safe region declared. Generate with scripts/compile_prompt.py.

video-campaign.title: Video campaign
video-campaign.use_when: User needs video: short-form vertical, product demo, founder story, testimonial, or ad cutdowns. Produces script, shot list, per-shot AI prompts, audio and caption direction, and delivery specs.

deliverables.title: Intake
deliverables.gate: Production reality is stated: what can actually be filmed, what must be generated, what already exists.

sections.vi: Mục tiêu và vị trí phát
sections.write: Where this plays, at what length, to whom, and what it must cause.
Phone, camera crew, AI generation, or existing footage. Budget and timeline.
Footage, stills, music licences, brand motion rules.

sections.vi: Yếu tố cố định và điều cấm
sections.write: Product truth, claims, people, music rights, and required disclosures.

deliverables.title: Video strategy
deliverables.gate: The hook is designed as a specific first-three-second event, not described as 'attention-grabbing'.

sections.en: One thing this video must land
sections.vi: Điều duy nhất video phải truyền tải
sections.write: One sentence.

sections.vi: Chọn định dạng và cấu trúc
sections.write: Demo, story, testimonial, process, before-after, UGC-native, explainer. Say why this one for this audience.
The exact first three seconds: what is on screen, what is said, what tension it opens.
How it reads with sound off, since much of the audience will watch that way.
Where attention will drop and what re-hooks it.

deliverables.title: Script
deliverables.gate: Spoken lines are timed and speakable aloud. On-screen text fits the safe area at the real font size.

sections.write: Timecode, visual, spoken line, on-screen text, sound. One table.
Exact strings in both languages, with character counts against the safe area.
Every claim spoken or shown, with its claim ID.

deliverables.title: Shot list
deliverables.gate: Generated by scripts/plan_video_sequence.py from a sequence spec, not typed by hand. The script refuses a screen-direction reversal on a straight cut, a generative shot over the drift ceiling, and durations that do not sum to the target, so a shot list that exists has already passed those checks.

deliverables.title: Storyboard
deliverables.gate: Frame notation shows composition and movement clearly enough to shoot from.

sections.write: So a non-filmmaker can read it.
Per shot: framing sketch in notation, movement arrow, subject position, text position.
Screen direction, eyeline, and what must match between shots.

deliverables.title: AI video prompts
deliverables.gate: Every shot prompt carries the same continuity lock, character for character, plus what it inherited from the shot before it. A prompt is not a rendered video.
deliverables.readme: Generate with scripts/plan_video_sequence.py --format prompts from the sequence spec; do not write one .txt per shot by hand. Two independently written descriptions of the same bowl are two different bowls, which is what made earlier shot prompts fail to join up. Add per shot only what the script cannot know: model name, duration limit, conditioning image, and whether audio is generated or added in post. Verify current model capabilities before use; they change frequently.

deliverables.title: Audio and captions
deliverables.gate: Music licence status is stated per track. Captions exist in both languages.

sections.write: Track direction, tempo, licence source and status. Never assume a track is cleared.
Language, register, pace, and whether human or synthetic. Disclose synthetic voice where required.
The specific diegetic sounds that make the product feel real.
Full caption file content in both languages, with line-length limits and reading speed.

deliverables.title: Cutdowns
deliverables.gate: Each cutdown still contains a hook, a mechanism, and a call to action. A cutdown is re-edited, not truncated.

sections.write: Per length: which shots survive, what the new hook is, what the new CTA is.
How each ratio is recomposed rather than centre-cropped, and where text moves.
For testing: the one thing that differs between test variants.

deliverables.title: Delivery specification
deliverables.gate: Every platform spec is verified against the official source with a retrieval date.

sections.write: Resolution, ratio, frame rate, codec, bitrate, maximum length and file size, caption format. Cite the source.
Where platform UI covers the frame, per surface, with measurements.
Applied consistently across cutdowns and ratios.
Captions, contrast of on-screen text, no flashing, audio description where relevant.

optimize-iterate.title: Optimize and iterate
optimize-iterate.use_when: Something is already running and results are known, weak, or confusing. Diagnose, form hypotheses, and change one variable at a time.

deliverables.title: Intake
deliverables.gate: The symptom is stated as an observation with numbers, not as an interpretation.

sections.write: What is observed, with numbers and dates. Not the assumed cause.

sections.vi: Điều gì đã thay đổi và khi nào
sections.write: Creative, budget, audience, landing page, price, season, platform. Timeline.
What exists, at what granularity, and what is missing or untrustworthy.

deliverables.title: Data audit
deliverables.gate: Small samples are flagged before any conclusion is drawn from them.

sections.write: Tracking gaps, double counting, attribution window, date range problems.
Per comparison: is there enough volume to conclude anything. Say plainly when there is not.
Computed with the formula shown.
What else was different between the conditions being compared.

deliverables.title: Diagnosis
deliverables.gate: Causes are ranked by evidence strength. Correlation is never written as causation.

sections.write: Where the loss actually happens, stage by stage, with numbers.

sections.vi: Nguyên nhân khả năng theo thứ tự
sections.write: Each with supporting and contradicting evidence.
What was considered and eliminated, with the reason.
One, with a confidence label and the cheapest test that would confirm it.

deliverables.title: Hypotheses
deliverables.gate: Each hypothesis is falsifiable and names the metric that would move.

sections.write: Because we observed X, we believe Y, so if we change Z then metric M moves by N.
Expected impact, confidence, and effort. Order the queue.
What must not get worse while this is tested.

deliverables.title: Test plan
deliverables.gate: One variable per test. Required sample is calculated. If it is unreachable, an honest alternative is proposed.

sections.write: Variable, variants, split, duration, and the single success metric.
Calculated, with the baseline rate and the minimum detectable effect stated.
Holdout, geo test, sequential read, or a qualitative decision. Say which and accept the limitation.
Written before launch: scale, hold, revise, or kill, at what threshold.

deliverables.title: Next creative brief
deliverables.gate: The brief changes exactly one named axis from the current creative and states what is preserved.

sections.write: The elements that evidence says are working. Do not restart from zero.
Named explicitly, with the reasoning from the diagnosis.
What must be made, at what cost, by when.
Which pipeline runs next and with what locked inputs.

deliverables.title: Decision log
deliverables.gate: Each entry records what was believed, what was done, and what actually happened.

sections.write: Date, decision, evidence, alternative rejected, outcome once known.
Written so the next run does not repeat this.
Owned and dated.

rewrite-human.title: Rewrite human
rewrite-human.title_vi: Viết lại cho ra tiếng người
rewrite-human.use_when: A draft already exists and reads machine-written or machine-translated. Includes any request to make copy sound human, to fix word-by-word translation between Vietnamese and English, or to transcreate an approved text into the other language.

deliverables.title: Intake
deliverables.gate: The source language, the target language, and which version is the original are stated. Every checkable fact in the draft is listed before any rewriting.

sections.write: The text verbatim, with its source and who approved it.
Which language is the original and which is transcreated, and why. Default: Vietnamese original, English transcreated.

Every checkable thing: numbers, dates, address, mechanism, price, guarantee. Label each confirmed/observed/inferred/unknown. Fewer than three means the copy has no content and rewriting cannot fix it.
Claims, numbers, legal disclosures, brand names and trademarked phrasing that must survive the rewrite byte for byte.

deliverables.title: Diagnosis
deliverables.gate: The measured output of scripts/rewrite_human.py is pasted, not summarised. Cadence failures and calque failures are separated.

sections.write: Paste the gate table and tell table from `python scripts/rewrite_human.py --check <draft>`.
Which gates failed and where in the draft each one comes from.
Which rows of data/translation-tells.csv fired, with the fix each one specifies.
Anything wrong with the truth, claim, offer, or audience fit. Say plainly if the real problem is that the copy has nothing to say.

deliverables.title: Rewrite
deliverables.gate: Every fact from the intake inventory is present in the rewrite. The rewrite is not longer than the original unless a named fact was added.

sections.write: The finished copy. Calques repaired first, then rhythm rebuilt around where each claim lands.

sections.vi: Đã đổi gì và vì sao
sections.write: Per edit: the failure it repairs. Not a list of synonyms swapped.
The intake inventory, ticked off against the rewrite. Name anything dropped and why.

deliverables.title: Verification
deliverables.gate: The re-measured output is pasted and no critical or high gate fails. A lowered target is not a pass.

sections.write: Paste the second run of `scripts/rewrite_human.py --check`.
Three consecutive sentences, checked for a repeating shape. Note what the ear caught that the script did not.
What still needs a human: unproven claims, market-specific legality, brand-voice judgement.

score-kpi.title: Score KPI
score-kpi.use_when: A scorecard has to be built, weighted, cascaded or scored. Includes building KPIs for a company, a department or a person, deciding aspect weights, choosing between lagging and leading indicators, and computing achievement and rank from targets and actuals.

deliverables.title: Intake
deliverables.gate: The level, the fiscal year and the owner are named. Every KPI has a stated source for its target, and a baseline or the absence of one is recorded.

sections.write: Company, department or individual, and whose card this is. A department card carries a fifth aspect for Dept Function; a company card does not.

sections.vi: Chiến lược mà thẻ điểm phục vụ
sections.write: The objectives this card is meant to move. A KPI that serves no stated objective is a measurement, not a scorecard row.
Last year's actual for every proposed KPI. Say plainly where there is none: a target set from no baseline is a guess, and it has to be marked as one.
Per KPI: who set the target and from what. Budget, board commitment, extrapolation or judgement.

deliverables.title: Card design
deliverables.gate: Weights sum to 100%, no KPI is under 5%, and every KPI states its direction and calculation method. Each aspect carries at least one leading indicator.

sections.write: The proportion per aspect, checked against data/kpi-aspect-weights.csv for the block. State the reason for any figure outside the guideline range.
Per row: code, aspect, KPI, measurement, unit, direction, calculation method, overall weight, lagging or leading. Overall weight is the stored figure; portion weight is computed from it, never typed.
Per KPI, which of the four branches applies and why: ratio higher-is-better, ratio lower-is-better, a named scale, or a date. Cost KPIs are scored target over actual.
The trap column from data/kpi-metrics.csv for every KPI used, and what was done about it.

Which rows come down from the level above and which come up from this level, roughly 70-80% down and 20-30% up. For an indirect cascade, name the parent KPI and say why this row is a leading indicator of it.

deliverables.title: Scorecard
deliverables.gate: The card is a JSON file that scripts/score_kpi.py scores without a blocking problem. Raw and capped achievement are both shown. A hand-typed achievement figure is a fail.

sections.write: The scorecard as JSON: level, owner, fiscal year and one entry per KPI carrying its weight, target, actual and scale.
Paste the output of `python scripts/score_kpi.py --input <card>.json`. Not a summary of it, and not a total retyped by hand.
Every KPI where the cap bit, with the raw figure beside the capped one. An override needs a named approver.

sections.vi: Số thực tế đã điều chỉnh
sections.write: Any actual that differs from the raw measurement, with the raw figure, the adjusted figure and the reason. An excluded month is an adjustment.

deliverables.title: Review
deliverables.gate: Every warning from the scoring run is answered, either with a fix or with a stated reason for keeping it. A total that agrees with a previous spreadsheet is not evidence.

sections.write: Each warning from the run, and the decision taken. An aspect with only lagging KPIs is reported but cannot be steered; say whether that is acceptable for the year.

sections.vi: Thẻ điểm này thưởng cho điều gì
sections.write: Read the weights back as behaviour. If the heaviest rows can all be hit without the strategy moving, the card is measuring the wrong things.
Per heavy KPI, the cheapest way to hit it without doing the work, and what stops that. On-time delivery is hit by quoting longer lead times.
Any target changed after the card was agreed, with the version number and a mandatory reason. Version two without a reason is not a version.
